label: scam
text:
Darb-Alert
Pending Status: Please settle overdue toll fees (AED4.00) to avoid the issuance of a AED100.00 fine and traffic points today, Jan 20.
Reply Y to open the secure payment portal.
source: https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/rak-police-warn-motorists-fake-toll-payment-messages
notes: Verbatim body as quoted by Khaleej Times. No link: asks for a reply 'Y' (replying re-enables links in iMessage). Sender number invented (report says random/international numbers).

label: scam
text: Roads and Transport Authority (RTA): The traffic management department has notified you that your unpaid traffic fine (50 dirhams) is due soon. Please pay immediately to avoid an automatic addition of 500 dirhams today, which could result in more severe penalties. https://rta-fines-ae.top/pay
source: https://gulfnews.com/uae/new-dh500-dubai-scam-alert-for-unpaid-traffic-fines-rta-warns-1.500418185
notes: Near-verbatim body as quoted by Gulf News; link invented (look-alike domain brand+'-fines-ae' on .top). Urgency + escalating penalty.

label: scam
text: Salik: Your vehicle trip fee has not been paid, please deal with it as soon as possible to avoid fines. https://salik-pay.cc/ae
source: https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/dubai-did-you-receive-this-fake-salik-message?amp=1
notes: Verbatim body as quoted by Khaleej Times; link invented (look-alike domain brand+'-pay' on .cc). Genuine Salik messages come from sender ID SALIK, not a number.

label: scam
text: Dubai Police: According to our records, you have recently been penalised for a road traffic offence. It is imperative that you settle this fine within 24 hours from the receipt of this message. Pay: hxxps://dubaipolice-fines[.]com/pay
source: https://khaleejtimes.com/uae/local-plus/uae-new-scam-alert-have-you-received-this-fake-dubai-police-message-asking-you-to-pay-traffic-fines
notes: Two sentences verbatim from the fake Dubai Police e-mail quoted by Khaleej Times, adapted to SMS ('email'->'message'); link invented and defanged (hxxps, [.]).

label: scam
text: Arizona toll services: We've noticed an outstanding balance of $11.69 on your record. To prevent a late fee of $50.00, please visit https://sunspasservicestoll.com
source: https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2024/05/text-about-overdue-toll-charges-probably-scam
notes: Verbatim text quoted in a reader comment on the FTC alert; the link is the reported one (the page printed it defanged, re-assembled here). Typosquat on SunPass. Sender invented.

label: scam
text: Your vehicle has an unpaid toll bill. To avoid excessive late fees on your bill, please settle it promptly. https://toll-servicecenter.xyz/us
source: https://www.yahoo.com/news/received-text-saying-unpaid-tolls-191437329.html
notes: Body as quoted from the FTC/FBI toll warning coverage (taken from the search-result excerpt of this page); link invented (.xyz).

label: scam
text: Dаrb: Your vehicle has unpaid toll trips totalling AED 36.00. Pay today to avoid a fine of AED 400 and black points: https://bit.ly/3Drb-AD
source: written in the style of the 'Darb-Alert' unpaid-toll campaign reported by Khaleej Times / Q-Mobility (https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/rak-police-warn-motorists-fake-toll-payment-messages)
notes: Cyrillic look-alike letter: 'а' (U+0430) inside 'Darb'. Link shortener bit.ly.

label: scam
text: شرطة أبوظبي: لديك مخالفة مرورية غير مسددة بقيمة 400 درهم. يرجى السداد خلال 24 ساعة لتجنب حجز المركبة ومضاعفة الغرامة: https://adpolice-fines.top/pay
source: written in the style of the fake traffic-fine link campaign Abu Dhabi Police warned about (https://gulfnews.com/uae/crime/scam-alert-abu-dhabi-police-warn-against-traffic-fine-suspicious-link-1.500243502)
notes: Arabic. Look-alike domain brand+'-fines' on .top. 24-hour deadline, impound threat.

label: scam
text: Du​bai Po​lice: تم تسجيل مخالفة مرورية على مركبتك. Fine AED 300 unpaid. ادفع الآن لتجنب حجز المركبة: https://tinyurl.com/dxb-fine-2026
source: written in the style of the Dubai Police fake traffic-fine SMS campaign (https://khaleejtimes.com/uae/local-plus/uae-new-scam-alert-have-you-received-this-fake-dubai-police-message-asking-you-to-pay-traffic-fines)
notes: Mixed Arabic/English. Zero-width spaces (U+200B) inside 'Dubai' and 'Police'. Link shortener tinyurl.com.

text: SALIK: Your Salik account balance is negative (AED -12). Top up within 12 hours to avoid a AED 100 fine per gate crossing: http://k7m2-pay.shop/salik.ae/topup

notes: Brand only in the path ('/salik.ae/' looks like the real domain but is a folder). Plain HTTP link. Sender is a phone number, not the SALIK sender ID.

label: scam
text: Notice: A discounted settlement is available for your toll gate violation. Pay only AED 4 today instead of AED 400. Offer expires at midnight: https://uae-tollgate-discount.xyz
source: written in the style of the 'Dh4 traffic fine' discounted-payment SMS campaign (https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/crime/dh4-traffic-fine-cross-emirate-fraud-network-busted-over-fake-sms-scam)
notes: Tiny fee lure to harvest card details. Look-alike generic domain on .xyz.

label: scam
text: Emirates Post: Due to incorrect address information, your package was not delivered, and the package was returned to the warehouse. Please update your shipping address and reschedule your delivery. https://emiratespost-verify.cc/track
source: https://khaleejtimes.com/life-and-living/uae-scam-alert-residents-warned-against-fake-delivery-messages-from-emirates-post
notes: Body verbatim as quoted by Khaleej Times; brand prefix and link added (look-alike domain brand+'-verify' on .cc). Report mentions a Malaysian (+60) sender; number invented.

label: scam
text: Your parcel has been delayed. Please update the address as soon as possible to pay for shipping. Reply 1 to get the link.
source: https://khaleejtimes.com/life-and-living/uae-scam-alert-residents-warned-against-fake-delivery-messages-from-emirates-post
notes: Verbatim as quoted by Khaleej Times. No link: asks for a reply so a link can follow.

label: scam
text: [U.S. Postal Service] We're sorry to let you know that your package could not be delivered. To reschedule a delivery please visit https://bit.ly/3xUsPs9
source: https://www.malwarebytes.com/blog/news/2022/04/usps-your-package-could-not-be-delivered-text-is-a-smishing-scam
notes: Verbatim as quoted by Malwarebytes, which printed the link only as 'bit(dot)ly'; the bit.ly code after the slash is invented.

label: scam
text: The USPS package has arrived at the warehouse and cannot be delivered due to incomplete address information. Please confirm your address in the link within 12 hours. https://usps.com-trackfix.top/us
source: https://it.brown.edu/phish-bowl-alerts/usps-delivery-scam-text-messages
notes: First sentence verbatim from the Brown University phish-bowl alert; second sentence and link written to complete it. Look-alike subdomain trick: 'usps.com-trackfix.top' (real domain is trackfix.top).

label: scam
text: USPS: Your package is pending delivery due to an unpaid shipping fee. Please update your information here to avoid return: https://usps-redelivery.info/fee
source: https://www.pandasecurity.com/en/mediacenter/spam-text-message-examples/

notes: Zero-width no-break space (U+FEFF) inside 'Aramex'. Link shortener cutt.ly. Small customs-fee lure.

notes: Cyrillic look-alike: 'Н' (U+041D) in 'DHL'. Look-alike domain brand+'-customs-ae' on .top. Generic alphanumeric sender 'Delivery', as DHL described.

text: FedEx: We attempted to deliver your package today. A redelivery fee of AED 5 applies. Schedule a new delivery: http://fedx-delivery.xyz/ae/reschedule
source: written in the style of the FedEx/courier redelivery-fee campaign (https://thenationalnews.com/uae/2023/01/05/uae-authority-warns-public-over-phishing-links-posing-as-major-courier-companies)
notes: Plain HTTP link. Typosquat 'fedx' on .xyz.

notes: Look-alike domain brand+'-redelivery' on .info.

text: بريد الإمارات: طردك محتجز بسبب رسوم توصيل غير مدفوعة (2.50 درهم). يرجى الدفع عبر الرابط لإعادة جدولة التوصيل: https://t.co/eP9xQ2LmZa
